name: max_standby_archive_delay
description: Maximum time a hot standby server waits before canceling conflicting queries while applying archived WAL data.
symptoms: Replication lag spikes under query load
Inconsistent query results due to premature cancellation
tuning_tips: Increase to reduce query cancellations when archived WAL replay conflicts with long-running reads; decrease to prioritize replication freshness over query stability. Set to -1 to disable timeout entirely, but only if application logic tolerates indefinite blocking.
